note: Norwegian night trains, one entry per direction, keyed by Back-on-Track's own trip label so the trainsByNumber enrichment finds the row it belongs to. Every entry is a NAMED ORIENTED pair rather than a route name, and the reason is the shape of a national feed: Entur files each night train inside a whole line that also runs day services — F4 Oslo S–Bergen among Vy's thirty-odd daily workings — so the trip with the most stations, which a plain name or { from, to } entry selects, is a DAY train. A named entry scans every trip and requires it to cross midnight. from/to are the feed's own station spellings; the probe's route list is where they come from. Verified against the live feed by `probe-gtfs --verify-allowlists` (the 'Probe GTFS feed' workflow). Go-Ahead Nordic (codespace goa): F5 Sørtoget is Back-on-Track row 65, Oslo–Stavanger. The probe reports F5 as a 04:19→12:05 day train because that is the fullest trip on the line; the 22:25 night train is one trip inside it.
